manual.detail: Producer logs show component byte sizes; consumers show payload and ZIP-stored bytes after verification. Optional manifest byte_sizes is checked when present; old version-2 manifests remain valid. No operator action or new GitHub read.

recovery.detail: No routing, timeout, retry or extraction-policy change. Diagnostic publication errors are optional; invalid present size metadata is refused.
